title: State Reducer Basics
description: Understand the state reducer pattern for flexible state management.

data.text: The **state reducer pattern** allows consumers to intercept and customize state changes. It's inspired by Redux reducers and gives users full control over how state updates.
Instead of directly updating state, the component calls a reducer function. The consumer can provide a custom reducer to override default behavior.

Use Cases
data.text: State reducers are useful when building reusable component libraries where users need to customize behavior without modifying source code.

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: State reducers give users control over component behavior.
